description.value:
Prerequisite: 16+ Cursed Energy score, Proficiency in Arcana

You have the unique ability to create cursed tools. The time it takes to make a cursed tool depends on the rarity of the item, and the rarity of item you can make is dependent on your level and you can spend 8 hours per day working on a cursed tool. After creating a cursed tool, you must wait an amount of time equal to its crafting time before working on another cursed tool. The GM decides the cost of any materials.

Level 1-4: Fourth Grade (Common)
Time: 72 hours
Level 5-8: Third Grade (Uncommon)
Time: 216 hours
Level 9-12: Second Grade (Rare)
Time: 648 hours
Level 13-16: First Grade (Very Rare)
Time: 1944 hours

system.requirements: 16+ Cursed Energy score, Proficiency in Arcana
